name: Map tract endpoint ROIs to cortical surface for quantitative analyses
summary: Maps volumetric tract endpoint ROIs onto FreeSurfer-derived cortical surfaces in native and MNI space with FreeSurfer mri_vol2surf and Connectome Workbench, with optional volume and surface smoothing, as a cortexmap.
description: Builds GIFTI surfaces from FreeSurfer (native and, with the warp, MNI), projects each ROI onto the surface with mri_vol2surf (projfrac-max from projfrac_min to 1), optionally smoothing the ROI volume beforehand and the surface map afterwards (wb_command -metric-smoothing). If an existing cortexmap is given, the ROIs are added to it. ROIs must be in the same space as the FreeSurfer anatomy. Requires a FreeSurfer license.

inputs.description: Volumetric ROIs (e.g. tract endpoint ROIs) as NIfTI files; each ROI is mapped onto the cortical surface.
inputs.requirements: ROIs must be aligned with the FreeSurfer anatomy.

inputs.description: The path to the top directory containing the output from Freesurfer

These files are needed to generate surfaces in template space (usually MNI). If you need to generate these files, please look at brainlife app FSL Anat. A version of this app not requiring this input is being generated
If cortexmap datatype has already been generated, update the datatype with the endpoint ROIs

outputs.description: The cortexmap output, containing the surfaces and mapped data
A directory containing all of the derivatives generated. Useful for QA and debugging

parameters.description: FreeSurfer surface parcellation (.annot) converted to GIFTI label files and written to the cortexmap label folder.
If you want to smooth the volumes before mapping to surface, input smoothing kernel (fwhm) here. If not, leave blank
If you want to smooth the surface ROIs after mapping to surface, input smoothing kernel here. If not, leave blank
if you want to treat zeros as not being data, set as true
If you want to treat "surface_smooth_kernel" as a fwhm instead of sigma, set to true
if endpoints aren't being mapped, try making this value negative (-1)
